title: CORS in ASP.NET Core
description: Configure CORS policies in .NET Web APIs.

data.text:
**CORS in ASP.NET Core**

ASP.NET Core provides built-in CORS middleware that can be configured with named policies or globally.

data.title: CORS Policy

items: Not specifying exact origins in production
Forgetting to apply policy to endpoints
Use exact origins, never wildcards in production

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Proper CORS configuration is critical for full-stack security.
